title: Limp mode and dealer handling
summary: Reviews in this topic mention both smooth driving performance and serious concerns about limp mode incidents, shutdowns of vehicle features, and unresolved dealer handling.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the car as comfortable and able to drive well.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on limp mode incidents, shutdowns of some features, and frustration that the dealer has not explained or inspected the car for ongoing problems.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review says the car remains parked at a dealer and the owner is unwilling to take it back, but the exact underlying issue is not stated.

limitations: This topic is based on very few reviews, so examples are limited.
The sample mixes vehicle performance comments with dealer or service experience, so the topic is not fully cohesive.
One fragment about features shutting down appears in the examples but is not assigned to a matching sentiment section here because its assigned sentiment and fragment sentiment differ.
